narrationTexts: Let me run the build first to confirm the failure, then fix both real bugs.
Confirmed: the deprecation warnings are just noise from the bump, but the link stage fails with a real error. Fixing both real call-site bugs in `options.js` and `retryPolicy.js`.
finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage (not the deprecation noise, which is harmless):

- `src/core/options.js` — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but this code still read `options.retries` (now `undefined`), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on `undefined`. Fixed to just check `=== true`.

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, sync loader hooks, etc.) — not build-breaking, just worth cleaning up on your own schedule.
